messages:
Maya: Heads-up — trying to get the release notes + changelog draft for the docs site pushed today. I have a PR ready but there's a couple of tricky known-issue callouts we should align on.
Liam: Which known issues? link rot? embed streaming?
Maya: Two things: 1) streaming embed edge-case where partial events show; 2) SDK snippet in the quickstart that uses the old SDK import path. Both are small but need clear wording and repro steps.
Sofia: For the embed streaming note — can we add a short mitigation (force-reconnect after 30s) rather than a full block? Product prefers mitigation > blocking note.
Kevin: Agree on mitigation. If we document a workaround we should flag it as "temporary" and add issue #7891 to the internal backlog link.
Maya: I'll add the temporary workaround text. Kevin can you paste the exact repro steps you used?
Kevin: Yep — paste below: ```bash
# repro on local with small window
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds/stream
# send two short inputs quickly, then close connection after the second chunk
```
Maya: Perfect, I'll include that in the Known Issues section.
Ryan: About the SDK snippet — is this the Python quickstart? The new import is `from redwood import Client` now, not `import redwood`.
Ben: I already opened a tiny PR that updates all quickstart snippets to the new import and pins the package version. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5123
Maya: Nice — can you add a short changelog bullet for the SDK import update? Something like: "SDK quickstart snippets updated to new import path (Python) — may require `pip install redwood>=1.2.0`"
Ben: Added the bullet in the PR description and included a migration note.
Sofia: We should also run a link-check sweep before merging. I found 2 internal links in the relnotes draft that 404 after moving the how-to pages.
Maya: Good catch. @Docs Bot, run link-check on the relnotes branch?
Docs Bot: Link-check queued for branch relnotes/2574823001 — results ETA 5m :gear:
Liam: While that's running, quick question on tone: do we want the relnotes to surface the fallback routing change as "beta" or just call it "preview"? Marketing prefers "preview".
Maya: Let's use "preview" to match marketing. Add parenthetical: (preview — opt-in).
Kevin: Also tagging eng-runtime for the streaming mitigation note in case they want to push a hotfix: @Liam @Ryan please review the mitigation text.
Ryan: Will review in 15.
Ben: Link-check results came back: two broken links (`/how-to/cache` and `/sdk/old-auth`). I updated `/sdk/old-auth` to point to the new auth guide; cache page needs a redirect.
Maya: I'll submit a small redirect PR for `/how-to/cache` to `/how-to/caching`. PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5130
Sofia: Can we include a short example snippet for the caching page in the relnotes? A 2-liner showing `client.cache.set(...)` would be helpful for users skimming the notes.
Maya: Good idea — I'll add this snippet under "Performance tips".
Maya: TL;DR plan: Ben's SDK import PR merges, Kevin + Liam finalize mitigation text, Maya adds repro + caching snippet + migration bullet, Docs Bot verifies links, I open redirect PR. Target: merge all and publish release notes by EOD. Any blockers?
Liam: Nothing else from infra.
Ben: No blockers.
Kevin: I'll post the final mitigation wording in the thread in 10.
Maya: Thanks. If anyone finds more 404s ping me here, I'll keep the draft open for quick edits. :pray:
